desc: 暖棕牛皮底厨房卷纸，湿水承重与吸液双栏实证，留白印章收口
leaf: 三层加厚强吸水厨房卷纸提装
name: 湿水强韧三层加厚厨房纸款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：整包塑封提装立於纯白底，干净合规、无任何文案与角标。
主图一秒法则：一页讲清分层强韧这一个核心利益，下方四枚用途图标带承接多场景覆盖。
shots.textZone: 顶部 25% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_1}」），四枚图标圆盘下方各留空白标签条（承接「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」）

shots.intent: 放大粘腻糖渍随手失控的真实瞬间，反衬分层纸张一擦即净的解决方。
shots.textZone: 左侧 40% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_2}」），人物与擦拭动作不入该带

shots.intent: 把纸张放回真实厨房台面，让家庭买家自我代入餐后清洁的一刻。
双栏同框湿水吊重台架，用一侧已裂一侧完好的可见差把强韧讲成证据。
shots.textZone: 顶部 20% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_3}」），两枚空白圆牌（承接「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」）

shots.intent: 同倾角双幅吸液对照，一侧淌下一侧锁住，一秒讲清吸液锁水差。
shots.textZone: 顶部 22% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_4}」），两枚空白放大镜圆盘下方各留空白说明行

shots.intent: 微距分层纸边与压纹面，用可见结构证明加厚材质而非口头主张。
shots.textZone: 右侧 45% 空白主张带（承接「{selling_point_5}」），无层数字样无数值

shots.intent: 由小到大三档纸幅平铺，让买家按污渍量自选用量，消除用量疑虑。
shots.textZone: 三枚空白圆牌与下方空白说明行（承接「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」），无档位字样

shots.intent: 以空白印章环与空白标签条收口信任，只留资质位不编造任何认证。
shots.textZone: 空白圆印章内圈与三枚空白标签条（承接「{callout_8}」「{callout_9}」），无机构名无编号无年份

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, flat warm kraft-cream #EFE1C8 fields for the benefit, strength and macro screens, full-bleed deep chestnut #5A3D26 wood-grain and flat fields for the pain-point, absorbency and variant screens, matte oak counter #C9A876 for the lifestyle screen, warm kraft-cream #EFE1C8 carrying a deep chestnut rounded card #5A3D26 for the trust close
style.direction: warm kraft household-paper commerce with flat chestnut and terracotta infographic panels
style.iconSystem: single-family thin-line outline glyphs in one uniform stroke weight, drawn in warm kraft-cream #EFE1C8 on flat deep chestnut #5A3D26 discs rimmed in terracotta #C2683C, no fill, no gradient, no shading
style.lightingSystem: warm high-key studio light with a broad front-right key, large bounce fill and soft contact shadows only, no hard speculars; macro lifted by a soft key skimming from camera left; both panels of any split screen share identical light direction, contrast and shadow length; flat panels lit evenly with no falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm kraft household-paper ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm kraft-cream #EFE1C8, deep chestnut brown #5A3D26 and one terracotta accent #C2683C; warm high-key studio lighting with a broad front-right key, large bounce fill and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with one heavy display headline band; single-family thin-line outline icon style on flat deep chestnut discs rimmed in terracotta #C2683C; clean high-end paper-fibre texture photography mixed with minimal flat infographic panels; stable slight 3/4 roll angle and sheet scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numerals.
noDrift: no invented numerals, units, timings or ratio marks
no brand wordmark, award lettering or certification seal artwork anywhere
style.presentationRules: carry pack always upright with roll tops forming one level row; a torn sheet always shows its layered embossed face toward the lens with the tear edge visible; both panels of any split screen share identical angle, crop, scale and light; the same sheet and embossing render in every size tier
style.surfaceSystem: matte oak kitchen counter #C9A876 and warm kraft-paper board #EFE1C8 as the surface language, brushed-metal spring clamps and slotted brass weight cylinders as the only hard materials, matte flat colour fields everywhere else, no gloss floor
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one heavy display headline band plus one light sub-line, words are only ever composited later into reserved blank bands, plates, discs and seal rings
